prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE standalone finished image, scene 1 of an original six-scene 2D animated modern girlfriend-and-boyfriend romance, story name outside the artwork "Our Little Pink Day". Landscape 16:9 desktop/laptop framing, requested 1920x1080, full canvas, no borders, comic panels, collage or UI.
ART DIRECTION: charming modern hand-drawn 2D romance animation with a contemporary webtoon/animated-short feeling; clean confident delicate outlines, soft cel shading, matte pastel painted backgrounds, expressive ADULT faces, cozy fashionable everyday styling. Dominant blush pink, soft strawberry pink, clean white and warm ivory; small charcoal and gentle green accents. Airy, polished, sweet and playful, with a tasteful Gen Z visual sensibility. NOT 3D, not clay, not photoreal, not chibi, not school uniforms. Characters are clearly young ADULTS, not teenagers.
DEFINITIVE CHARACTERS: exactly two adults. Girlfriend age 22: warm medium-brown skin, oval face, warm brown eyes, shoulder-length wavy dark-brown hair with a single small plain white bow clip on her left side; oversized plain blush-pink hoodie, white wide-leg trousers, chunky white sneakers with pale-pink sole details, small simple round stud earrings. Boyfriend age 23: warm medium-brown skin, brown eyes, short fluffy tousled black hair, clean-shaven, slightly taller; oversized plain creamy-white hoodie, powder-pink straight-leg trousers, white sneakers with a little blush trim. Adult proportions with a natural relative height difference. No writing, logos or graphics on any clothing. These faces, hairstyles, outfits, footwear and accessories must be the exact designs for the following scenes.
SETTING: a lovely contemporary pedestrian street with a small pink-and-white cafe, plain scalloped ivory awning, white-framed windows, pale pink tiled walls, cream pavement, a few flower pots and soft spring greenery. Absolutely no cafe signage, menu writing, numbers, posters, brands or labels. Bright soft daylight, gentle shadows, no crowd.
SCENE 1: The sweetest meetup. The girlfriend at left and boyfriend at right meet outside the cafe, facing each other with shy delighted smiles, their inner hands gently reaching toward each other at waist height. Their free hands rest naturally. Medium-wide/full-body three-quarter composition with both faces clearly recognizable and most of each outfit visible. A light breeze lifts just a few hair strands. Capture the feeling of an everyday date that means a lot, warm eye contact and tiny blush. Beautiful airy pink-and-white surroundings without excessive floating hearts, stickers or decorations.
ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT anywhere: no letters, numbers, captions, titles, watermarks, logos, signage, menus, typography, speech bubbles or interface elements. No extra people, no fantasy powers, ghosts or Halloween props. No sexual content, no extra limbs, malformed hands or face distortion.
